{{Quote|In the caverns of Marka Ragnos is the beast he left to guard his legacy. Go there, sit among the flames, and wait for the beast to come for you.|Overseer Tremel, to the acolyte|<ref name="Slaying the Beast" />}}
The '''Beast of Marka Ragnos''' was a [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]] [[Terentatek/Legends|terentatek]] that was kept as a pet by [[Marka Ragnos]], an ancient [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] and ruler of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]. Following Ragnos' [[Death/Legends|demise]] in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], the Beast was left to guard the [[Tomb of Marka Ragnos|resting place]] of its master on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. After [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] of isolation in Ragnos' [[Cave/Legends|caverns]], the Beast was ultimately slain by a [[Empire's Wrath|rising star]] of the reconstituted [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] who had entered the [[Burial/Legends|tomb]] as part of the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy's]] trials.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Return to the Valley of the Dark Lords and find the tomb of Marka Ragnos. I'll see you when the beast is slain. Good luck.|Overseer Tremel, to a promising Sith acolyte|<ref name="Slaying the Beast" />}}
[[File:JKAhs_ragnos.png|thumb|left|200px|Marka Ragnos, master and persecutor of the Beast]]
As its name implied, the Beast of Marka Ragnos once belonged to the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Marka Ragnos]],<ref name="Beast" /> who ruled over the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] for a [[Standard century/Legends|standard century]].<ref name="GAOTS3">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 3|''Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith'' 3]]</ref> The Beast was a giant [[Terentatek/Legends|terentatek]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]]. Legend held that Ragnos, despite considering the Beast his "pet," used to beat it at [[Standard day/Legends|night]] in order to increase its ill emotions. The same legend also reported that the Beast was only [[Diet/Legends|fed]] with [[Blood/Legends|blood]] between two periods of deprivation, which gave it an unquenchable thirst for more.<ref name="Beast" />

By dint of [[Torture/Legends|torture]], Ragnos' pet was ultimately turned into an embodiment of pure hatred. When Ragnos [[Death/Legends|died]]<ref name="Beast" /> in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]],<ref name="Birth" /> the Beast was left to guard the [[Tomb of Marka Ragnos|burial chamber]] of its master, nestled in the [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. For many centuries, the Beast of Marka Ragnos served its purpose, and no one who had seen it lived to tell the tale.<ref name="Beast" />

Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Dates" /> [[Overseer (Sith)|Overseer]] [[Tremel]] of the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on Korriban ordered a [[Empire's Wrath|promising Sith Warrior]] to enter the [[Burial/Legends|tomb]] as a test of worth. Tremel advised his [[Sith acolyte/Legends|acolyte]] to hold nothing back, as he considered the creature to be "doom itself." The Sith Warrior discovered the reliquary containing an ancient Sith carving that could summon the Beast and [[Meditation/Legends|meditated]] around it for a moment, prompting the creature to appear. True to its mission, the Beast confronted the Sith Warrior but was ultimately slain. Since Ragnos' pet had been a great source of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] energy on the planet, its death caused a [[Disturbance in the Force/Legends|disturbance in the Force]].<ref name="Slaying the Beast" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Hold nothing back. This creature is doom itself.|Overseer Tremel, to the Sith acolyte|<ref name="Slaying the Beast" />}}
Like all terentatek, the Beast of Marka Ragnos was a massive biped distinguished by its thick [[Limb/Legends|forearms]], the spines growing from its back, and a pair of<ref name="Slaying the Beast" /> [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] [[Tooth/Legends|tusks]].<ref name="Asc">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]''</ref> Its thick, [[Hair/Legends|hairless]] hide had a [[Color/Legends|grayish]] hue.<ref name="Slaying the Beast" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|The beast of Marka Ragnos was a great source of dark energy here on Korriban. When it was slain, there was a tremor in the Force.|Overseer Tremel, to the Sith acolyte|<ref name="Slaying the Beast" />}}
As a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] life-form, the Beast only used brute force to attack its enemies, but it could also [[Stun/Legends|stun]] them with a blow of its fists.<ref name="Slaying the Beast" /> Its powers were great enough to impress a confirmed Sith Overseer and prompt him to advise caution about fighting the creature. In fact, Tremel explained that a [[Vergence/Legends|vergence]] in the Force was located on the Beast, which was itself a source of dark energy.<ref name="Slaying the Beast" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Beast of Marka Ragnos appears in the [[Sith Warrior]] class mission "Slaying the Beast" in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'',<ref name="Slaying the Beast" /> a [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]].<ref name="TORRelease">{{TORweb|url=news/news-article/20111014-1|text=Global Launch for The Old Republic}}</ref>
